caption: The yellow shared bicycle next to the power box on the right side of the stairs has turned its front wheel to the left. The fire extinguisher on the wall on the right side of the scene has rotated from facing forward to facing backward.

The blue and white rectangular cushions on the lower bed have disappeared. The black blanket at the foot of the lower bed has disappeared. The brown stool with four legs, placed to the right of the lower bed against the wall, has disappeared. A person wearing a white top and blue pants appears on the gray mattress at the bottom of the bed, facing the wall behind the bed. The word "Rost" in glowing blue letters has appeared on the wall behind the upper and lower beds.
The blackboard at the front of the classroom, behind the teacher's podium, has increased in size. The first row of school desks on the right side has shifted forward.

A black speaker has newly appeared on the right side wall above the teacher's podium. A person wearing a hat, a dark jacket, shorts, and yellow shoes appears at the door on the right side of the classroom, facing the front of the classroom with their back to the camera. The red fire extinguisher hanging on the right wall of the classroom is no longer present.
The bouquet of blue and purple flowers on the bedside table to the left of the first bed on the right side of the scene has been replaced with a bouquet of blue flowers.

A man in a red shirt and blue shorts appears on the right side of the road, walking towards the building on the left side of the scene. The red car on the rooftop of the green building on the right is replaced by a green sofa.
A man wearing a black sweatshirt, black pants, and white shoes has appeared on the left side of the stairs. He is holding a camera in his right hand and facing the stairs.
A new blue sign with the word "Cautiuos" has appeared on the wall above the electric vehicle.
The white ball that was on the right side of the picnic blanket, in front of the blue and white lounge chair, is no longer visible.

The yellow non-motorized vehicle next to the power box on the right side of the hallway has turned its front wheel to the left. A man wearing a gray coat, blue pants, and white shoes has appeared on the middle step of the stairs in the distance, with his hands crossed in front of him, facing the yellow non-motorized vehicle.

The ladder has changed from blue to black. A person wearing a white long-sleeve shirt, blue pants, and black shoes is sitting on the floor mat at the foot of the bed, with their legs bent and resting against the bed frame, arms wrapped around their legs, and their head lowered. The word "Rest" in glowing blue letters has appeared on the wall behind the lower bed.

The word "Efficient" written in light blue letters on the floor is no longer visible. A woman wearing a black hat, an orange coat, black leggings, and black boots has appeared near the center of the scene, facing away from the camera towards the desks with computers.
